judge.rationale: Agreement is limited: KCNK9/TASK-3 provides a comparable leak-conductance mechanism in B–D, but A instead centers KCNJ2, while C adds KCNK2 and D adds KCNK3, leaving A with no mechanistic marker overlap and roughly half or more of the complete contributor coverage differing, so the shared-minority ceiling of 4 applies.
